entities.name: Sanda Rašković Ivić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sanda Rašković Ivić is a former Serbian politician, psychiatrist and psychotherapist. She was the president of the Democratic Party of Serbia from 2014 to 2016. She has served as one of the vice-presidents of the People's Party since 2017 and is currently serving as a member of the National Assembly of Serbia.
